The Role As a Country Process Specialist , you will be responsible for managing and coordinating the complete student application process for your assigned country/countries. You will work closely with students, counselors, universities, admissions teams, visa teams and internal departments to ensure that every application progresses accurately, efficiently and within the required timelines. Key Responsibilities 1. Student Profile Assessment Review student academic profiles, financial backgrounds and overall eligibility. Assess suitability for different universities, programs and countries. Work closely with counselors to identify appropriate application strategies. Ensure students receive accurate information regarding admission and documentation requirements. 2. University & Course Applications Manage end-to-end university application processes. Prepare, verify and submit applications and supporting documents. Monitor application status and follow up on pending requirements. Maintain accurate application records and trackers. Ensure applications are submitted within university and country-specific deadlines. 3. University Coordination Communicate with university admissions and international offices. Follow up on applications, offers, conditions and outstanding documents. Coordinate with university representatives regarding student cases and application queries. Resolve application-related issues and escalate complex cases when required. Maintain strong professional relationships with university partners. 4. Offer & Admission Management Track offers, conditional offers and unconditional offers. Coordinate fulfilment of offer conditions. Ensure students understand their next steps, deposits and required documentation. Coordinate with counselors and students until the admission process is successfully completed. 5. Visa Process Coordination Coordinate with the visa processing team to ensure smooth transition from admission to visa. Verify country-specific visa documentation and timelines. Track visa application readiness and pending documents. Support students and internal teams with process-related queries. Stay updated on relevant country-specific visa and compliance requirements. 6. Process & Compliance Follow standardized SOPs and country-specific processes. Identify gaps, delays or recurring errors in the application process. Recommend improvements to increase efficiency and service quality. Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails. Ensure adherence to institutional, internal and regulatory requirements. 7. Student & Stakeholder Support Handle student and parent queries related to applications and admissions. Coordinate effectively with counselors, customer service, finance, visa and management teams. Ensure timely communication and a positive student experience. Take ownership of cases until resolution. 8. Reporting & Performance Tracking Maintain daily/weekly application trackers. Monitor applications, offers, deposits, visa files and pending cases. Track turnaround times and process performance. Prepare regular reports for management. Identify bottlenecks and recommend corrective actions. 9. Training & Knowledge Sharing Stay updated with changes in university requirements, application processes and visa regulations. Support training of counselors and new team members. Develop and maintain country-specific process guidelines, checklists and FAQs. Share updates and best practices with the wider team. Who Are We Looking For? We are looking for professionals who are organized, detail-oriented, process-driven and comfortable working with students and international universities. Desired Skills Experience in overseas education, student recruitment, university admissions or visa processing. Strong understanding of international application processes. Excellent documentation and coordination skills. Strong written and verbal communication. Ability to manage multiple student applications simultaneously. Strong follow-up and deadline management skills. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities. High attention to detail. Ability to work with CRM systems, spreadsheets and application portals. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders. Customer-focused approach with strong ownership of assigned cases. Experience 1- 5 years of relevant experience in overseas education, university applications, admissions, student services, visa processing or related operations will be preferred. Freshers with strong communication, analytical and organizational skills may also be considered for suitable positions. Educational Qualification Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Operations, International Education, Commerce, Arts or a related field. Relevant overseas education, admissions or visa-processing experience/certification will be an advantage. What You'll Get to Work On This is not a back-office data-entry role. You will be involved in the complete international student journey , including: Profile Assessment → Country & University Shortlisting → Application → University Coordination → Offer Management → Conditions → Deposit → Visa Coordination → Pre-Departure You will gain exposure to international universities, country-specific admission systems, student profiles and evolving global education processes. Job Details Position: Country Process Specialist Location: Vadodara, Gujarat Work Mode: Full-Time | On-Site Industry: Overseas Education / International Student Recruitment Experience: 1- 5 Years preferred Department: Operations / Admissions / International Applications Interested? If you are passionate about international education and enjoy process management, student interaction, university coordination and application operations , we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and become part of the Global Colliance team.

review_candidates.title: Integrated Marketing Executive
review_candidates.description: Who We Are Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world. We innovate fearlessly, guided by our core values and driven by the belief that conventions were meant to be challenged. We foster a culture in which every associate feels welcomed and respected, where leaders and creatives are inspired to shape the world of tomorrow by taking bold action today. POSITION SUMMARY- "Marketing GTM Coordination & Operations" The Integrated Marketing Executive will play a critical role in supporting the development and execution of New Balance Korea's integrated brand marketing plans and Go-To-Market (GTM) processes. This role will be responsible for supporting annual and seasonal marketing planning, coordinating GTM timelines and cross-functional alignment, managing key planning and budget processes, and ensuring seamless execution of marketing initiatives across the organization. The position requires a highly organized and proactive marketer who can translate consumer insights, business priorities, and brand objectives into actionable marketing plans while effectively managing multiple stakeholders and ensuring operational excellence throughout the marketing planning and GTM lifecycle. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Integrated Marketing Planning Support the development and execution of annual and seasonal integrated marketing plans aligned with brand and business objectives. Coordinate marketing priorities across multiple functions to ensure consistency and alignment of brand initiatives. Develop and maintain annual marketing calendars, campaign roadmaps, and activation plans. Support the planning and execution of key brand campaigns, product launches, and consumer engagement initiatives. Monitor campaign performance and provide recommendations to optimize marketing effectiveness. Ensure marketing plans are aligned with consumer insights, commercial priorities, and regional brand strategies. Marketing Budget Management Support the development, tracking, and management of annual marketing budgets. Monitor budget utilization and ensure investments align with approved marketing plans and strategic priorities. Prepare budget reports, forecasts, and spending updates for key stakeholders. Partner with Finance and Marketing teams to support reforecasting and budget allocation decisions. Identify opportunities to improve spending efficiency and maximize marketing investment effectiveness. GTM Planning & Coordination Coordinate seasonal GTM planning processes to ensure alignment across Marketing, Merchandising, Commercial, Retail, and Regional teams. Manage key GTM timelines, milestones, and planning deliverables. Support launch readiness planning for key product and campaign activations. Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, gaps, or dependencies that may impact execution. Facilitate seasonal marketing orders by tracking key order windows and coordinating product requests across footwear and apparel seasonal products to ensure marketing needs are incorporated into the GTM process. Consumer Insights & Market Intelligence Support the development of local consumer insights and market intelligence. Analyze consumer trends, market developments, competitive activities, and campaign performance. Translate insights into recommendations that enhance planning and decision-making. Share key findings and opportunities with internal stakeholders. Marketing Operations & Planning Support the development of local consumer insights and research, enabling cross-functional marketing teams to create campaigns that are locally relevant and meaningfully connected to consumers. Maintain marketing calendars, project trackers, and planning tools to ensure visibility and accountability across teams. Consolidate updates, action items, and key decisions from various marketing functions. Coordinate marketing product orders to support campaigns, athlete and influencer seeding, events, and brand initiatives. Support the planning and coordination of key ad hoc marketing projects and initiatives. Assist with budget tracking, reporting, and administrative processes as needed. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management Work closely with Marketing, Commercial, Merchandising, Retail, Digital, and Regional teams to support integrated planning and execution. Build strong working relationships across departments to facilitate efficient communication and decision-making. Partner with Regional Marketing teams to ensure local plans are aligned with regional and global strategies while reflecting local market needs. Facilitate alignment among stakeholders to ensure marketing priorities, timelines, and deliverables are clearly communicated and executed. REQUIREMENTS Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred but not required. 2-4 years of experience in marketing, brand management, project coordination, marketing operations, or related functions. Experience in consumer brands, retail, fashion, sporting goods, or lifestyle industries preferred. Strong project management and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail. Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities. Analytical mindset with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and cross-functional environment. Professional proficiency in both Korean and English, both written and spoken. PERSONAL SKILLS Analysis & Organization: Ability to organize and coordinate Korea marketing game plans across cross-functional teams while managing multiple priorities effectively. Leadership: Proactively identify solutions to issues and opportunities, demonstrate initiative, and maintain a positive "can-do" attitude. Teamwork: Strong team-player mindset with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams on various projects. Communication: Excellent interpersonal communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate points of view and recommended actions. Results Driven : Ability to measure, evaluate, and report on the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and brand KPIs. Time Management: Ability to manage multiple priorities, demonstrate strong organizational skills, and effectively prioritize workload. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION Location: Seoul Anguk, Korea, Korea / Department: Marketing Equal Opportunity Employer: New Balance is committed to equality of opportunity for all current and prospective associates regardless of age, disability, race, religion or belief, gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, marriage and civil partnership and gender reassignment. We are an equal opportunity employer and support a culture of diversity and inclusion. If you have not already done so, please let us know if you require any support so we can make the right adjustments and considerations should they be required.
